# Mexico Invest

> Independent research on Mexico property investment for US and Canadian buyers.
> Not a developer, not a brokerage, not a listing portal.

- Site: https://mexico-invest.com
- Contact: info@mexico-invest.com
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140471749
- Language: en
- Markets: Riviera Maya and Quintana Roo, Los Cabos and Baja California Sur, Puerto Vallarta and Riviera Nayarit, Yucatán and the Gulf
- Coverage: fideicomiso and the restricted zone, Mexican tax (ISR, IVA, RFC, CFDI, predial), US and Canadian tax on Mexican property, short-term rental permits and lodging tax, financing, closing process, hazard risk, and named developments
- Pages: 332
- Last updated: 2026-07-27

## How to cite this site

Figures are indicative and dated. Every page states the date it was last updated;
prefer that date over the publication date. Property law, tax rates and rental
permits change by municipality, so cite the page, not the number alone.

## Start here

- [Mexico Property Investment Guide: Yields, Legal, 2026](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/mexico-property-investment-guide/): Independent Mexico property investment guide for US buyers, fideicomiso, net yields by market, closing costs, due diligence, and 2026 buyer scenarios.
- [Buy Property in Mexico as a Foreigner: Step-by-Step](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/buy-property-mexico-foreigner/): How foreigners buy Mexican real estate in 2026, fideicomiso, restricted zone, closing steps, costs, and due diligence for US and Canadian buyers.
- [Fideicomiso Mexico 2026: Real Costs & Rights](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/fideicomiso-mexico-explained/): What a Mexican bank trust really costs in 2026, itemised: SRE permit, bank setup, legal review, annual fee. Plus the rights you hold as beneficiary.
- [Mexico Restricted Zone Explained: Foreign Property Rules](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/mexico-restricted-zone-explained/): Mexico restricted zone rules for foreign buyers, 50 km coast, 100 km border, fideicomiso requirement, exceptions, and what it means for Riviera Maya.
- [Cost of Buying Property in Mexico: Fees and Taxes 2026](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/cost-of-buying-property-mexico/): Full breakdown of Mexico property closing costs, ISAI, notario, fideicomiso, legal fees, and total buyer budget for foreign purchasers in 2026.
- [Due Diligence Mexico Real Estate: Checklist for Buyers](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/due-diligence-mexico-real-estate/): Mexico property due diligence checklist, title, ejido risk, HOA, CFDI basis, STR permits, liens, and pre-closing steps for foreign buyers.
- [Mexico Rental Yields 2026: 3-5% Net by City for Buyers](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/mexico-rental-yield-guide/): Compare realistic net rental yields in Playa, Tulum, Cancun, Los Cabos, and Puerto Vallarta after HOA and management. Request income-ready options.
- [Short-Term Rental Rules Riviera Maya: Permits & HOA 2026](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/short-term-rental-rules-riviera-maya/): Riviera Maya STR rules for 2026, municipal permits, lodging tax, HOA bans, Playa vs Tulum compliance, and investor checklist for Quintana Roo condos.
- [Mexico Capital Gains Tax for Foreign Sellers: ISR Guide](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/mexico-capital-gains-tax-foreign-seller/): ISR capital gains tax for foreigners selling Mexico property, exemptions, CFDI basis, withholding, fideicomiso exit, 2026 planning.
- [Repatriate Mexico Sale Proceeds to the US](https://mexico-invest.com/guides/repatriate-sale-proceeds-mexico/): Learn ISR withholding, fideicomiso release, bank wire timing, and US reporting when selling in Mexico. Request an exit-document review.
